website.notes: Homepage: 'Digit is a humanoid robot with 65,000 hours of real production experience. Arc is the cloud platform that runs your fleets.' Digit assembled by the Agility team in Salem, OR (RoboFab). Digit 5 billed as 'our first cooperatively safe humanoid'; footnote says Digit 5 is in development and specs subject to change. Careers page (https://www.agilityrobotics.com/careers): offices in Salem OR (HQ, manufacturing), Pittsburgh PA (testing, validation, skills), Fremont CA. Values: Take ownership; Build trust through collaboration; Create value through adaptability. Company overview (https://www.agilityrobotics.com/company-overview): CEO Peggy Johnson (ex-Magic Leap CEO, ex-Microsoft EVP BD); COO Jennifer Hunter (bio calls her Chief Financial & Operating Officer, 'shaping the financial and operational strategy as the company transitions from prototype to full-scale commercialization'; ex-COO SunPower, ex-COO/CFO Nimble Robotics); CFO Michael Beer; CBO Daniel Diez; CTO Pras Velagapudi; Chief Hardware Officer Marco Marroquin, whose org includes Hardware Technical Program Management; co-founder and Chief Robot Officer Jonathan Hurst.

media.notes: Press release 2026-10-13: S-4 with Churchill Capital Corp XI declared effective; shareholder meeting 2026-11-02; expected Nasdaq ticker AGLT; more than $620M gross proceeds incl. ~$200M PIPE led by Foxconn. 'Earlier generations of Digit have accumulated more than 65,000 hours of real-world operation.' Digit 5 unveiled, more than $300M in committed orders (subject to contractual milestones), early access customer availability in early 2027. RoboFab in Salem designed to produce up to 10,000 robots annually. New hardware and physical AI development hub in Fremont, CA opened July 2026. Goals through year-end 2027: pipeline from 30+ to ~100 customers; committed customer facility deployments from nine to up to 25. NVIDIA Halos launch partner; Toyota Motor Manufacturing Canada RaaS agreement. Also 2026-10-20 press release: AGCO commercial agreement, pilot at Hesston, Kansas, expected to begin in 2027; combination expected to close Q4 2026.
